title: ShipmentNoticeErrorResponse
description: Error body of GET /shipment-notices/{token} (JSON, the default). Mirrors ShipmentNoticeErrorBodySchema in apps/backend/src/modules/order-ingestion/shipment-notice-contract.ts. Errors from the order service carry `type` and `message` (and sometimes `code`); errors from the gateway (unknown token, request validation) carry `error` and sometimes `message`.
